source_acquisition.observational_fields_excluded: setup and jet seconds/callback counts; all mathematical fields retained

shared_model.complete_residual_defect: C*[d0 delta+d1 delta_x+d2 delta_xx], combined at coefficient level before interval evaluation

prefix_cover.quadrature: signed complex interval range integral, including all prefixes and partial last cells

historical_residual_preparation.scope: Historical descriptive observation, not a matched benchmark. Calibration needs the source setup PLUS recombined mixed coefficients, polydisk majorant, residual prefix and anchor export.

cost_scope: Descriptive work/times only; source setup acquired once for all source-informed routes; historical residual majorant/coefficient/prefix setup and anchor construction required for calibration. No matched-cost claim.
scope: Real-only first jets on B. No calibrated second-jet or complex-disk residual bound, new coverage or Newman bound.
